title: Collection runs and raw records
description: Inspect collection runs, immutable raw responses and sync cursors. Raw data never writes directly to canonical matches.
syncHint: Only active Sportmonks sources in testing mode are allowed. Each action safely pulls one page into reviewable mappings.
liveScoreHint: Pull the current livescore window into reviewable status and score candidates. Canonical match status and scores are not changed.
lineupHint: Pull lineup, bench and formation candidates for one Sportmonks fixture ID. Provider prediction and confirmation flags are preserved without writing canonical lineups.
eventHint: Pull goal, card, substitution, penalty and VAR event candidates for one Sportmonks fixture ID. Events follow sort_order without changing canonical events or scores.
statisticHint: Pull team and player fixture statistics with provider type metadata. Values remain candidates and do not change canonical match data.
standingHint: Pull the complete table for one Sportmonks season. League and group-stage rows remain reviewable candidates and do not change canonical standings.
commentaryHint: Pull the English commentary timeline for one Sportmonks fixture. Original text and changed snapshots remain reviewable candidates and are not published automatically.
typeHint: Pull Sportmonks event and sub-event dictionaries into the review center. No event, score or canonical match data is changed.

messages.synced: Data pulled; candidate data is ready in the mapping center
messages.duplicate: Duplicate payload; returned the existing record by hash
messages.failed: Operation failed. Check source status, credentials, plan access, or network.
messages.fixtureRequired: Enter a valid Sportmonks fixture ID.
messages.seasonRequired: Enter a valid Sportmonks season ID.
messages.noCheckpoints: No checkpoint is available for this cursor
messages.reasonRequired: Enter an operation reason of at least 3 characters
